=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- changelog.d/5327-pinned-guard-verifier.md
  Line or code reference: line 12 — "What this means for contributors: a change to scripts/guard_differential.py takes effect once it has merged, on every CI run that starts afterwards..."
  Problem: The audience-closing takeaway says changes take effect "once it has merged" without qualifying the bootstrap case. Line 4 of the same fragment describes the bootstrap fallback ("A base branch that does not carry the verifier yet runs the PR's copy"), but a contributor reading only the takeaway paragraph — which §20.D of CLAUDE.md defines as the standalone operational summary — would not know that during bootstrap (base lacks the verifier) the PR's copy runs before merge, so the change is in effect immediately.
  Why it fails at runtime: No runtime failure. This is a documentation accuracy gap on a security-sensitive mechanism. An operator deciding whether a verifier fix protects an already-open PR during the bootstrap window could draw the wrong conclusion from the takeaway alone.
  severity=low | confidence=3
- agents.md
  Line or code reference: lines 1249-1252 — "The base is fetched when the step runs, so a change to the verifier applies only once it has merged, and then to every run that starts afterwards, including new runs on PRs that were already open."
  Problem: The "so" connector scopes this to the non-bootstrap case (base has the verifier), and the bootstrap case is described in the immediately preceding sentence (1245-1248). The wording is accurate in context, but a reader who skims past the preceding bootstrap sentence could misread "applies only once it has merged" as universal. In bootstrap, the PR's copy runs before merge (ci.yml:522), so the change is in effect immediately.
  Why it fails at runtime: No runtime failure. The preceding context mitigates the concern — the bootstrap fallback is explicitly documented two sentences earlier. This is a minor clarity gap, not a misleading statement when the paragraph is read in order.
  severity=low | confidence=2
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
